remarks: Back on the Market after improvements! Gorgeous Nantucket-Style Retreat with Spacious Layout & Private Backyard Set behind stately stone pillars, this stunning Nantucket shingle-style home, fully renovated in 2011, offers timeless curb appeal and modern comforts throughout. With 4 bedrooms, 3 full baths, and thoughtfully updated newer construction, this home is designed for today's lifestyle. The heart of the home is the beautifully updated eat-in kitchen, which flows seamlessly into a generous family room, formal dining room, and large living room-ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. A versatile first-floor office or 5th bedroom provides flexibility for guests or work-from-home needs. Upstairs, you'll find spacious bedrooms, including a serene primary suite and bonus/rec room with added french doors for privacy. A two-car garage and ample driveway space ensure plenty of parking for family and guests. Step outside to an expansive patio with fire pit and an enormous private backyard -perfect for summer gatherings, play, or peaceful outdoor living. This exceptional property blends classic coastal charm with modern convenience. A true gem you won't want to miss! Located in the brand new Ox Ridge School District.
